### Phase Q7: effective-scale cold bracketing, duplicate-price suppression, bounded Quality top-off, and exact saturation reporting

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.quality-q7-effective-scale-controller/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Continue the diminishing-returns quality/speed pass in the exact target-rate controller. Make Cold bracketing geometric in the ladder's true effective scale across the dense post-ceiling HfMul segments, suppress repeated exact prices of an already-seen rung without changing trace order or the hard budget, and report saturation when the top rung was actually priced feasible even if entropy non-monotonicity leaves a closer coarser incumbent. Reinvest at most one already-budgeted exact price for post-ceiling Quality finalists on frames up to 5 MP, while larger frames retain the requested tolerance as their stop. Preserve every public entry point and the never-over, representable-rung, deterministic tie-break, non-monotone-pocket, and error-propagation contracts. Promote only if corpus quality stays within Contract B and exhaustive high-rate price counts and wall time improve.
